name: Appture Pay
author: Appture Pay

sections.description:
Unify Payment and Shipping Providers with Appture Pay to allow event driven pay-outs to your service providers. Appture Pay adds a Payment Provider and a Shipping Provider to your Woocommerce installation. Just create a quick Appture Pay account, add a Client and your on your way to receiving payments as well as dispatching a courier in order to fulfill your orders. For merchants residing in South Africa.

Donation Forms

  1. Open Appture Pay > Donation Forms and add a form.
  2. Configure its amount and once-off or recurring options.
  3. Enter a non-confidential API client identifier, or sign in to select or create a public client.
  4. Publish the form, then use its shortcode, Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, or copy its standalone HTML.
sections.installation:
1. Head over to the Appture Pay website and complete the following steps
    a. Create an account at https://app.appturepay.com/user/register
    b. Complete account FICA
    c. Install and activate the Appture Pay plugin, then open Appture Pay > Setup in WordPress.
    d. Keep Connect account selected and sign in with your Appture Pay account. Your account username and password are used only for this sign-in and are not saved by WordPress.
    e. Under Create a client for this website, confirm the client name and choose whether to start in sandbox mode.
    f. Click Create and use client. The plugin creates a confidential API client, configures this website’s redirect and callback URLs, and saves the generated Client ID and Client Secret automatically.
  2. Test a payment while the client is in sandbox mode, if selected, before enabling live payments from your Appture Pay account.
  3. To use an existing client instead, select it after signing in and enter its Client Secret once for verification. Appture Pay does not return secrets for existing clients.
  4. Alternatively, select Enter details manually and provide a Client ID and Client Secret yourself. Ensure the client’s redirect and callback URLs match those shown on the plugin settings page.
sections.changelog:
1.9.0

  • Add reusable donation forms backed by non-confidential Appture Pay API clients.
  • Embed forms with a shortcode, Gutenberg block, or Elementor widget.
  • Export standalone form HTML for use outside WordPress.
  • Select or create a public API client from the donation form editor.
  • Create, edit, and refresh donation forms from the Gutenberg and Elementor controls.
  • Split the admin area into Dashboard, Setup, Donation Forms, and Diagnostics screens.
  • Redirect successful account-assisted and manual client changes to the dashboard.
  • Allow account-authenticated administrators to verify or replace an existing client secret and change sandbox/live mode.
  • Preserve connection method, client mode, name, and timestamp after account-assisted setup.

1.8.5

  • Add a read-only Appture Pay log viewer to the Debug options tab.
  • Support recent WooCommerce file and database log storage.

1.8.4

  • Remove obsolete MemberPress support and detection.
  • Keep the plugin focused on WooCommerce and WooCommerce Subscriptions.

1.8.3

  • Show the Appture Pay setup dashboard on the main plugin menu page.
  • Remove the unconditional missing-plugin warning shown there.

1.8.2

  • Move logging and debug email controls to a dedicated admin tab.
  • Keep client and debug settings isolated when either form is saved.

1.8.1

  • Add a connected-client dashboard to the admin settings page.
  • Update account registration and password recovery links.

1.8.0

  • Add guided Appture Pay account connection and API client selection/creation.
  • Keep account login credentials out of local storage and use a short-lived admin token.
  • Retain manual API client configuration.

1.7.0

  • Tested with WooCommerce 11.0.1.
  • Add Checkout Block payment-method support and declare Cart/Checkout Blocks compatibility.
  • Make callback handling idempotent and serialize concurrent callbacks.
  • Complete HPOS migration for courier order metadata.
